payload.name: Count owned items across event and profile memories
payload.description: When a question asks how many of a category a person has or owns and no direct summary count exists, search event plus profile/state memories, not just acquisition events.
content: When counting items a person owns or possesses, do not limit retrieval to event memories. Also run structured or hybrid searches across profile, state, and event memory kinds using the entity plus the category (e.g., "<name>'s dogs", "<name> owns", "<name> has a pet") and predicates like owns, has, pet.

Enumerate distinct named instances from both acquisition events and profile/state ownership facts; count those whose world_start is on or before the target date and whose world_end, if any, is after the target date.
When an event or plan mentions a named companion, inspect or search profile/state memories for that name to confirm whether ownership already exists before counting or excluding it.
Stop after retrieving all candidate instances or after one additional targeted search that returns no new instances; do not exhaustively expand.

solves: Answers undercount or overcount ownership/possession questions because retrieval is restricted to acquisition event memories, while current possessions are often stored as profile or state facts and acquisition events may not match the chosen keywords.
